I am farming millet on my small plot here in the North West. Money is tight, so I will buy only a little urea to boost the millet, and I spread the manure from my goats and sheep on the field before planting like we always do. I keep my own millet seed from last harvest because the improved seed is costly and hard to find in my village, and with no river or pump nearby I depend on the rains. My wife and children help me with weeding and harvest, but I will hire a few young men for a couple of days when the weeds get heavy.
